symptom: my servo jitters badly on the Pi 5 even though the code worked on an Arduino. I'm using RPi.GPIO software PWM at 50Hz.

files.servo.py:
import RPi.GPIO as GPIO
import time
GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
GPIO.setup(17, GPIO.OUT)
p = GPIO.PWM(17, 50)
p.start(7.5)
while True:
    time.sleep(1)

gold.diagnosis: Software PWM under a non-realtime Linux kernel has timing jitter that makes servos stutter, and RPi.GPIO is broken on Pi 5 anyway. Use gpiozero's Servo/AngularServo, which uses lgpio's hardware-timed PWM on Pi 5.
